events.text: RHB Banking Group increased its sustainable finance target to RM50 billion by 2026.
RHB Banking Group unveiled a comprehensive pathway to achieve net zero emissions by 2050.
RHB Bank's SME Green Renewable Energy and Capex Financing covers purchase of energy-efficient equipment and machinery with financing rates from as low as around 4.5% and up to full financing margins.

Sustainalytics opined that RHB's Sustainability Sukuk and Bond Framework aligns with the Sustainability Bond Guidelines 2021, Green Bond Principles 2021, Social Bond Principles 2021 and ASEAN Sustainability Bond Standards 2018.
RHB launched its Sustainable & Transition Finance Framework, which has been fully validated by an independent second-party opinion from Sustainalytics.

On 11 July 2024, BNM issued Administrative Monetary Penalties to four financial institutions, including RHB Bank, for failing to comply with reporting and regulatory requirements, with penalties totaling up to RM2.5 million.
On 10 July 2025, the court allowed RHB Bank Berhad's winding-up petition against Dermaga Oil & Gas Sdn Bhd, with the company filing a notice of appeal on 29 July 2025.
